solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Hood being worn in sleeveless coat

indicators.note: in says the item worn sits inside the coat's letters

parts.note: a cape is a coat without sleeves
clothes being worn are on

explanation.surface: A hood, the garment, is being worn with a cape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hood' looks like part of the clothing picture, but it means a gangster, a hoodlum.
explanation.definitionFit: Al Capone was the most famous Chicago gangster, and a hood is slang for a gangster.

clue.text: Threaten to collect runs, except for opener

indicators.note: to collect means the threatening word gathers in the abbreviation for runs

parts.note: to cow is to intimidate
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
bar means except, as in all bar one

explanation.surface: A cricket picture: threatening to pile up runs, apart from the opening batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opener' looks like the first batsman in cricket, but it is a tool for prising things open.
explanation.definitionFit: A crowbar is a lever used to force things open, so it is an opener.

clue.text: Possible brew in teapot beginning to leak

indicators.note: brew suggests stewing the letters of in teapot together into something new
beginning to takes only the first letter of leak

explanation.surface: A potential brew in a teapot that is starting to leak.
explanation.definitionFit: Potential describes what may happen or develop, so it means possible.

clue.text: Australian native miners on strike

parts.note: the NUM is the UK's National Union of Mineworkers
to bat is to hit

explanation.surface: Native Australian mine workers walk out on strike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on strike' reads as industrial action, but strike is just a verb meaning hit.
explanation.definitionFit: The numbat is a small striped marsupial found only in Western Australia, an anteater.

clue.text: Brief shorts with tight top entering county

indicators.note: entering puts the rearranged letters inside the county's name

parts.note: Hants is the short form of Hampshire, an English county

indicators.note: tight means drunk, so the word top is reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A description of skimpy shorts worn with a close-fitting top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tight' seems to describe the top garment but is the anagram signal, meaning drunk. Hants is short for Hampshire, a county in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot pants are very short, tight shorts, so brief shorts describes them directly.

clue.text: Heading off, Venetian traveller touring southern European city

indicators.note: touring means going around, so the shortened traveller surrounds the abbreviation
heading off removes the first letter

parts.note: Marco Polo was the famous traveller from Venice

explanation.surface: Without his chief, a Venetian traveller tours southern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heading off' trims POLO to OLO; 'touring' puts it around S.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital of Norway, so it is a European city.

clue.text: Sponge where jumper located, perhaps?

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, who jumps out of aircraft
a site is where something is located

explanation.surface: A sponge might be where a jumper is found, a wry question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sponge' looks like a bath sponge or cake; here it means a freeloader.
explanation.definitionFit: A sponger lives off others, and a parasite is the same sort of freeloader.

clue.text: Chip ends in pan, salsa and garlic, fish too

indicators.note: ends in takes the final letter of each word listed

explanation.surface: Cooking with chips, salsa and garlic in a pan, plus fish too.
explanation.definitionFit: A nacho is a tortilla chip, usually served with cheese and salsa.

clue.text: Cooks bagging fifty honours

indicators.note: bagging means capturing, so the cooking word holds the numeral

parts.note: to saute is to fry quickly
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Chefs earning fifty awards.
explanation.definitionFit: To salute someone is to pay them respect, which is to honour them.

clue.text: Cooking pot, one degree tops

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters of pot are being worked into a new form

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
MA, Master of Arts, is a university degree

explanation.surface: A cooking pot that earns a degree with top marks.
explanation.definitionFit: Optima are the best possible values or outcomes, the plural of optimum, so they are the tops.

clue.text: Church circle upset with a Lutheran at first

definitions.note: used adjectivally, as in church matters

indicators.note: upset signals that circle together with a are thrown into disorder
at first takes only the opening letter of Lutheran

explanation.surface: A church congregation is disturbed alongside a Lutheran.
explanation.definitionFit: Clerical means relating to the clergy, the church's ministers, as in church affairs.

clue.text: Track south of constellation, source of reference

indicators.note: in a down clue, south of means placed below the constellation

parts.note: Libra is a constellation of the zodiac
RY is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A track running south of a constellation, a guide for navigation.
explanation.definitionFit: A library holds books for consultation, so it is a place to find reference material.

clue.text: Troublesome situation in the country for son of Jacob

indicators.note: in says the tricky situation sits inside the country's name

parts.note: Benin is a country in West Africa
being in a jam is being in a fix

explanation.surface: A tricky predicament in some nation affecting a biblical son of Jacob.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Benjamin is the youngest of the twelve sons Jacob fathered, born to Rachel.

clue.text: Highlander bearing right behind English companion

indicators.note: behind puts the Highlander part after the abbreviation for English
bearing means carrying, so the Highlander holds the letter for right

parts.note: a Highlander is a Scot

explanation.surface: A Scottish Highlander keeps to the right behind an English companion.
explanation.definitionFit: An escort accompanies someone, as a partner on an outing or a guard on a journey.

clue.text: Is mother in Hades not entirely a patriarch?

indicators.note: in places the mother word inside the shortened underworld
not entirely drops the last letter

parts.note: Hades, the underworld, is hell
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Asking whether a mother in the underworld is only partly a patriarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not entirely' drops the final letter of the underworld word before the mother goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Ishmael, son of Abraham, is regarded in Islam as a forefather of the Arabs, a patriarch.

clue.text: One entering race total

indicators.note: entering puts the numeral inside the word for a race

parts.note: to race is to run
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A single competitor is entering a race in full.
explanation.walkthrough: 'total' looks like a noun or adjective, but it is the verb meaning to wreck completely.
explanation.definitionFit: To total something, a car especially, is to wreck it beyond repair, to destroy it.

clue.text: Essentials second among load of underwear?

indicators.note: among puts the abbreviation for second in amid the underwear pile

parts.note: piles of bras would be bra stacks

explanation.surface: A moment spent rummaging through a pile of underwear for the essentials.
explanation.definitionFit: To get down to brass tacks is to deal with the basic facts, so the phrase means fundamentals.

clue.text: Tissue, article used to catch a germ, primarily

indicators.note: to catch means the jumbled article holds the next letters inside
used means worn and knocked about, so the letters of article are mixed up
primarily takes the first letter of germ

explanation.surface: A piece of tissue used to trap a germ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' rearranges ARTICLE to CARTILE; A plus G goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartilage is the tough connective tissue in joints, ears and noses.

clue.text: Sunken design inside label on upside-down painting

parts.note: in means inside
a tag is a label

indicators.note: in a down clue, upside-down means the painting word reads backwards

parts.note: an oil is a painting

explanation.surface: A sunken pattern found inside a label on a painting hung upside-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Intaglio is a design cut or engraved into a surface, so it is sunk below it.

clue.text: Is it I? It is I! That's it!

definitions.text: Is it I? It is I! That's it!

parts.words: Is it I? It is I! That's it!
parts.note: the first two sentences read the same in both directions, and the last points out that they are an example of such a sequence

explanation.surface: Someone asks if it is them, confirms it, and declares the matter settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is it I' and 'It is I' each read the same letter by letter backwards, and 'That's it!' names what they are.
explanation.definitionFit: A word, phrase or sentence that reads the same forwards and backwards, like 'Is it I', has this name.

clue.text: Man drinking wine in the early hours

indicators.note: drinking means taking in, so the chess piece swallows the wine

parts.note: a pawn is a chess man
red is a wine

explanation.surface: A man drinking wine in the early hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Predawn means occurring before daybreak, during the early morning hours.

clue.text: Pull tie

definitions.meaning: to pull, as a cart is ... along
a match ending level, with no winner

explanation.definitionFit: A cart is hauled along by being drawn, and a game finishing level is called a drawn match.

clue.text: Wife riding kangaroo perhaps, great story!

indicators.note: in a down clue, riding means sitting on top of the next piece

parts.note: a kangaroo is one example of a hopper

explanation.surface: A wife riding a kangaroo would make a tall tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A whopper is a big lie, a tale that is hard to believe.

clue.text: Stick together, chap having broken heart

indicators.note: having broken says the chap has burst into the heart word

parts.note: the core is the heart of something
he is a chap

explanation.surface: A man with a broken heart should stick together.
explanation.definitionFit: To cohere is to stick together, like particles or ideas that are united.

clue.text: Catch husband, perhaps, endlessly lying around

indicators.note: lying around means turned the other way, so the trimmed word is read backwards
endlessly says the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a husband is one kind of partner

explanation.surface: A spouse is caught out by endless lies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts PARTNER to PARTNE; 'lying around' turns that back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: To trap someone is to catch them by trickery, which is what entrapping means.

clue.text: Save up sovereign for potato

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: save means except, like but
ER, Elizabeth Regina, was the sovereign

explanation.surface: Save up a gold sovereign to buy a potato.
explanation.definitionFit: A potato is an example of a tuber, the swollen underground stem of a plant.

clue.text: I'm jumping into guano, minor ego repelled

indicators.note: repelled says the hidden letters are read backwards
into says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone with a small ego announces a leap into bird droppings and is sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'into' in the definition, leaving the hidden word with no signal; 'into' is that signal, and 'I'm jumping' alone is the cry. 'repelled' turns the run round.
explanation.definitionFit: Paratroopers famously shout this name as they leap from the aircraft, so it is the cry of someone jumping.

clue.text: Rival testament in mail, case dismissed

indicators.note: in places the testament letters inside the middle of mail
case dismissed removes the outer letters of mail

parts.note: NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A legal rival's will in the post, with the court case thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: To be anti something is to be opposed to it, so a rival stance.

clue.text: Stewed lamb with tuna on the move!

indicators.note: stewed implies the lamb and tuna have been cooked together into a new mix

explanation.surface: A curious stew of lamb and tuna, served on the go.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambulant means able to walk about, so a person who is ambulant is moving around.

clue.text: Leave wet clothes entirely clean, initially

indicators.note: clothes is a verb here: the wet word dresses, so surrounds, the first letters

parts.note: wet means damp

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: Instructions to leave damp clothing fully clean at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' looks like a noun but is a verb meaning wraps around.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave suddenly or secretly, originally of breaking camp.

clue.text: Nitrogen and oxygen in freezing drug

parts.note: N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

indicators.note: in places the oxygen symbol inside the freezing word

parts.note: arctic means freezing cold
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A chemistry recipe: two gases in a frozen state make a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: A narcotic is a drug that dulls the senses, such as opium or morphine.

clue.text: Behind police, eggs thrown over shooter

indicators.note: behind puts the reversed eggs after the police word

parts.note: the Met is London's Metropolitan Police

indicators.note: thrown over means turned the other way, so the eggs word reads backwards

parts.note: roe is fish eggs

explanation.surface: Behind the police lines, eggs are hurled at a gunman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shooter' suggests a gun, but means a shooting star.
explanation.definitionFit: A meteor is a shooting star, streaking across the night sky.
